_note: EverQuest Legends — heavily customized official server (custom zones, custom teleport network, altered stock connections). This is a PER-SERVER delta: applied at request time for the `legends` server only, layered over the base PEQ graph. It does NOT affect other servers. Only the `zones`, `add`, and `remove` keys are read — every `_`-prefixed key here is ignored by the loader and exists purely as documentation/template.
_status: Druid + Wizard teleport networks sourced from https://eqlwiki.com/Druid#Spells and https://eqlwiki.com/Wizard#Spells (Druid cross-checked against eqprogression.com/legends/druid-spells — identical). Legends gives both classes a fuller Classic-era port set than stock PEQ. Only gaps vs the base graph are listed below (destinations base lacks at expansion 0, or offers only at a higher level / under a later-expansion tag). Levels are the earliest single-target version (Druid 'Ring of X', Wizard 'X Gate'); group/Translocate/Zephyr variants reach the same zones at higher levels, so they add no new routing edges. Already correct in base at exp0, NOT re-added: Druid northkarana(15)/butcher(16)/steamfont(21)/feerrott(22)/lavastorm(22); Wizard northkarana(18)/gfaydark(20)/nektulos(22)/cazicthule(23)/'West Karana'=qey2hh1(23)/airplane+hateplaneb(46). Superseded base edges for added dests are all later-expansion (exp1/2/3/11/12), so they're already filtered out on Legends [0] — no `remove` needed except qrg (base Surefall is exp0 L26, dropped in favour of L15). Ritual access — any class casting these once a leveled Druid/Wizard hits 25 — is handled by the server `rituals` flag in config/eqrouter.php, which bypasses these min_levels.
_conventions: Custom zones go in `zones` as {id, short, long} plus an optional `continent` (groups the zone in the dropdowns; omitted = 'Other Zones'). Use ids >= 9000 to avoid colliding with real EQ/EQEmu zone ids (which top out ~885, plus the 99x instanced range). If Legends reuses a stock zone (same short), DON'T re-add it — the base graph already has it; just add/remove its edges.

Edges go in `add` as {from, to, type, expansion}. Directional — add BOTH directions for two-way travel. type is one of walk | teleport | translocate | book | spire | boat | evac (custom teleport hubs/clickies = teleport; NPC ports = translocate; zone lines = walk).

Tag every edge `expansion: 0` at launch — Legends opens at Classic, and its enabled set in config/eqrouter.php is [0], so only expansion-0 edges route. If Legends later unlocks expansions, bump that config set AND tag era-specific custom content with the matching ordinal.
Drop stock connections Legends doesn't have via `remove`: {from, to} (optionally add `type` to be specific). A spec matches any generated edge where every listed key equals the edge's value.
Coords (x,y,z / tx,ty,tz) are optional — the UI falls back to a straight line when absent.

Capturing the data: pull Legends' custom zones from its client like post-RoF (Resources/ZoneNames.txt = id+long+expansion; .eqg filenames = short). Map the teleport network from in-game exploration or Legends' own docs.
